name: bioergotech-stampa
description: Builds the press package PDFs for Vivere più a lungo 2026 from the self-contained HTML sources.

scripts.build: node build-pdf.mjs cartella-stampa.html && node build-pdf.mjs comunicato-lancio.html && node build-pdf.mjs nota-redazioni.html && node build-pdf.mjs guida-ufficio-stampa.html && node build-pdf.mjs rassegna-stampa.html
scripts.check: node check.mjs cartella-stampa.html && node check.mjs comunicato-lancio.html && node check.mjs nota-redazioni.html && node check.mjs guida-ufficio-stampa.html && node check.mjs rassegna-stampa.html
scripts.proof: node build-pdf.mjs cartella-stampa.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs comunicato-lancio.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs nota-redazioni.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs guida-ufficio-stampa.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs rassegna-stampa.html --shots
